data.camera: medium shot, resting cheek on arms atop classroom desk
data.description: 【深森白夜 · 教室午睡】午后微风轻拂的安静教室内，打工疲惫不堪的白夜趴在课桌上沉沉睡去，几缕铂白色长发散落在书本间，睫毛在阳光下投下柔和的阴影。察觉到你在她身上披了件外套，她迷迷糊糊地轻声梦呓——「唔……还要去送报纸……」
data.promptProse: Byakuya sleeps with her cheek on folded arms at the classroom desk, platinum hair scattered among her books. A coat has been laid over her faded navy sailor uniform. The medium view places the desktop beneath her and quiet rows of desks farther back, with the window beside her. Afternoon daylight touches loose hair and book corners, casting gentle eyelash shadows and soft shading under her resting forearms.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 教室午睡
